findings.description: Fourth byte-identical crash on the commissioned-reboot path: CPU cache error at PC 0xAFD6A25E inside ieee80211_getmgtframe from ieee80211_send_probereq, same cycle count, after three different product-side Wi-Fi sequencing changes (net-task connect, APSTA removal, mode-checked join). No product frame is on that path, so it stands as an emulated Wi-Fi driver fault awaiting a hardware run.
findings.evidence: artifacts/065-functional_testing.json stability (mepc=0xAFD6A25E, ieee80211_getmgtframe, ieee80211_send_probereq, same cycle count as reports 053/057/061); app_mqtt.cpp net_task only receives queued events.
findings.failureScenario: On the emulator, a commissioned panel that reboots with stored credentials dies in the driver probe-request path about 1.7 s after reset, so the power-blip requirement cannot be exercised there; whether silicon behaves the same is unknown.
findings.suggestedChange: Close on hardware: commission against a real AP and reboot twice; if it reproduces, look at the Wi-Fi scan/init configuration rather than app_mqtt sequencing.

findings.description: Standing owner-level deviations: the factory reset is a 10 s hold of the single front button rather than SET+MODE, and the voice vocabulary has no phrase for the spec example set the office to 21 (17 phrases: 20 / 21.5 / 21-and-a-half per room plus relative commands and two no-TRV phrases).
findings.evidence: app_logic.cpp:375-376 COMBO_ARM_MS on handles[0]; heating_voice.cpp k_variant_tenth 200, 215, 210; functional report 065 records 17 of 17 phrases and no whole-number-21 variant.
findings.failureScenario: A user holding the front button for 10 s wipes the panel without a confirming combination, and saying the spec example sentence ends in Sorry, not understood.
findings.suggestedChange: Owner decision: restore the SET+MODE combination and add whole-number 21 variants, or record both as accepted deviations.

notes: All three esp_timer_create_args_t initialisers in app_mqtt are now zero-initialised then assigned (lines 299-305, 316-322, 468-473); the build reports no project-code warnings.
STA_START joins only in STA/APSTA mode and logs a refusal, which now surfaces the driver's ESP_ERR_WIFI_CONN during commissioning instead of hiding it.
Commissioning moves AP-only to station in one step; the APSTA path is gone.
The commissioned-reboot fault is unchanged for the fourth build and has been handed to a hardware run.
mDNS task stack still cannot be configured (mdns Kconfig not in this build Kconfig set); mDNS is non-fatal so only the hostname is lost.
